camera: Innomaker U20CAM-720P (D-023), as a7z_cam.py publishes it: 1280 x 720 MJPEG shrunk to 640 x 360 and turned 180 deg to upright
pixel_convention: continuous: the centre of pixel column j, row i is (j + 0.5, i + 0.5); OpenCV's cx, cy plus 0.5
why: No calibration yet. Equidistant fisheye (r = f theta) from the manual's 102 deg horizontal FOV over 640 px: f = 320 / rad(51) = 359.5 px, centre at the image centre. It gives 117 deg on the diagonal against the manual's 120 (a pinhole with 102 deg horizontal gives 110). Manual: INNO-MAKER/U20CAM-720P UserManual-v1.0.pdf page 3 (guide/print/face-u20/checks.json fromManual). Replace with cam_calib.py --intrinsics; approach.py refuses to run while source is datasheet.
